gen-gf-gugi-gf-mukta: Distinctive from the first letter, Gugi draws its strokes like bent wire, with lowercase that nearly reaches the capitals. But Mukta underneath is a tidy, quiet sans that lets the heading do the talking.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-play: Gugi's lowercase stands tall, nearly matching its capitals. Gugi does best with a pencil-line consistency up top, while Play handles the text with the mild stroke variation of a letterpress slug.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-rambla: Bold, tube-like Gugi holds its thickness through every bend, its lowercase rising near capital height. And it earns its keep when set big and short, while Rambla stays a quieter sans underneath.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-roboto-condensed: Tight-set and smooth, the body text glides under the eye like wire. Roboto Condensed carries the steady reading, while Gugi saves its tall, open-cut letters for the heading itself.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-saira-semi-condensed: Saira Semi Condensed reads large and steady, its weight unvarying from one word to the next. And Gugi supplies the swagger on top, its cut-open terminals making the text beneath feel more settled.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-secular-one: Secular One fills every line with a dominant midsection and zero modulation, a sturdy, modern workhorse. Yet Gugi above it keeps things lively, its open-cut terminals adding a distinctive, bold edge.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-smooch-sans: Gugi's line keeps a constant weight tracing every letter. Smooch Sans then reads quickly and closely packed, its generous s bends and high midline keeping the text moving along.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-sofia-sans-condensed: Sofia Sans Condensed leaves its curves unfinished where the pen lifts, giving friendly text with no calligraphic shading to guide the eye. Reading it feels approachable and brisk, with Gugi leading above.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-spline-sans-mono: Spline Sans Mono sets fixed-width, code-style letters in a bold, uniform stroke, with lowercase nearly matching its capitals. Precision is what stands out most here, against Gugi's distinctive heading.
gen-gf-gugi-space-grotesk: Space Grotesk keeps its counters open and its lines constant. Gugi does best with its high lowercase and cut-open terminals up top, while Space Grotesk handles the text at a moderate height.
